data.description: Exceptional Amenities | Stunning Property | Unique Design
data.display_address: Orchid B, Orchid, DAMAC Hills, Dubai
data.long_description:
Orchid is a well-appointed apartment complex situated in the serene suburb of Damac Hills. Comprising two 10-story residential towers, Orchid Building A and Orchid Building B, this development offers a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. The surrounding area features playgrounds, landscaped green spaces, and parks, making it perfect for those who enjoy outdoor activities. Orchid Building A is conveniently located near the Trump International Golf Club, a renowned local attraction.


  Residents of Orchid benefit from a range of onsite amenities and modern facilities, including:


 Swimming pool and lounge area
 Fully equipped gym
 Covered parking
 Centralized air conditioning
 Comprehensive security and video surveillance
 Landscaped gardens and promenade areas
 Proximity to supermarkets, sports fields, and public transportation


  Damac Hills, part of the larger Dubailand area, is celebrated for its extensive green spaces and lakes, as well as its well-developed infrastructure. The area is home to the Trump International Golf Club, a major draw for golf enthusiasts.


  Orchid is conveniently located just a two-minute walk from the Carrefour supermarket and its adjacent bus stop, as well as a skatepark and a dog walking park. Within a five-minute walk, residents can access a tennis area and a beautifully landscaped park. Additionally, the community center and beach area are just a short five-minute drive away.
